description.description: Description of the query. Max size = 256.

action.description: The default security action associated with this threat.

category.description: The classification of the threat (e.g., malware, phishing, spyware, high-risk).

id.description: The unique system identifier for this metadata record.

name.description: A unique, user-friendly name for the threat. Required field. Max length of 128 characters.

threat_content_version.description: The version of the threat intelligence database that contains this threat signature.

threat_id.description: The unique identifier assigned to the specific threat or vulnerability signature.
